name: Sentiments Enneigés
source:
Déborah doesn't like to go outside, in fact she would be much better under her duvet instead of having to watch her sister. At least that's what she thinks!

[From [url=https://nighten.itch.io/neige]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黛博拉不喜欢出门。与其在外面照看妹妹，她宁愿窝在自己的被子里。至少，她自己是这么想的！

[摘自[url=https://nighten.itch.io/neige]itch.io[/url]]
